I never imagined I would have to ask for help like this. My name is Wedad, and I am from P.a.l.e.s.t.i.n.e. My family consists of 7 members. Our home was completely destroyed, and now we are living in a torn tent with nothing left. My family and I have not had any food for the past 32 hours. Watching my family suffer from hunger is heartbreaking, and every hour feels endless.

My mother is sick, and my sister Mira is also sick. They both urgently need medicine and medical care, but we cannot afford it. I feel helpless watching them suffer while we have no food and no way to help them.

If you are able to help, your d.o.n.a.t.i.o.n can provide food for my family and medicine for my mother and my sister Mira. If you cannot donate, please share our story with others. Your kindness and support could give my family hope during this heartbreaking time. Thank you for reading my story.

I am reaching out with a heavy heart to ask for support for my family. My name is Wedad, and we are a family of 7 living under extremely harsh conditions. Having lost our home, we currently shelter in a fragile tent with very little warmth or protection. Access to basic food and clean water has become a daily struggle for all of us.

Both my sick mother and young sister Mira require ongoing medical attention and treatments that are simply out of our reach right now. It is deeply painful seeing loved ones in pain without the resources to ease their burden.

Any assistance or donation, no matter how modest, directly helps us secure food rations and essential medical supplies. If contributing is not possible, sharing our message is equally meaningful. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your compassion and time.

Please take a moment to read our urgent plea. My name is Wedad, writing on behalf of my displaced family of 7. Ever since our house was ruined, survival has been an ongoing challenge. Food shortages are severe, and our living quarters offer almost no shield against the cold.

Compounding our crisis, my mother and my little sister Mira are ill and in desperate need of pharmaceutical care and doctor visits. Without timely medical relief, their health continues to decline.

If you have the means to assist, your generosity will go directly towards meals and life-saving care. Even simply forwarding or sharing this appeal brings us closer to safety and comfort. We are truly grateful for any empathy and support you can offer.

My children are not asking for toys. They are not asking for anything expensive. They are simply hungry and looking for food. 💔

For more than 32 hours, we have had almost nothing to eat. They search through our destroyed home for clothes and anything they might still use. We have no money left to buy food.

My little daughter Mira is seriously ill and her iron level has fallen to 6. She urgently needs medicine and treatment. At the same time, we are living close to the Yellow Line and trying desperately to raise enough money to move somewhere safer.

Please help me protect my children. A small donation can become a meal for them or medicine for Mira. ❤️

I am Suhaila from Gaza, and I am asking you to please help my family. 💔

My five children are hungry. For more than 32 hours, we have had almost nothing to eat, and we no longer have money to buy food. They search through our destroyed home for clothes because we cannot afford to replace them.

My husband is injured and cannot work. My little daughter Mira is seriously ill, with an iron level of 6, and needs urgent medicine and medical treatment. We are also close to the Yellow Line and need money to move somewhere safer.

Please donate if you are able. Even a few dollars can help feed my children or help Mira get the medicine she needs. Please share if you cannot donate. 🙏

The most painful feeling for a mother is hearing her children say they are hungry and having nothing to give them. 😭

For more than 32 hours, my children have had almost nothing to eat. They search among the remains of our destroyed home for clothes and anything useful because we have no money left. I feel helpless watching them suffer.

And while my children are hungry, my little daughter Mira is fighting illness. Her iron level has fallen to 6, and she urgently needs medicine and treatment. We are also close to the Yellow Line and need money to move somewhere safer.

Please help my family survive this moment. Even a small donation can bring us food, medicine, and a little hope. ❤️

This is what our life has become: children searching through the ruins of their own home for clothes while their mother worries about where the next meal will come from. 💔

For more than 32 hours, we have had almost nothing to eat. We have no money left for food. My husband was injured and cannot work, and my little daughter Mira is seriously ill. Her iron level has fallen to 6, and she needs urgent medicine and medical care.

We are close to the Yellow Line and desperately need funds to move to a safer place. Please don't let our story disappear. If you can donate, even a small amount would help us. If you cannot, please share. ❤️

Today I am not asking for anything luxurious. I am asking for something every mother should be able to give her children: food. 💔

For more than 32 hours, my five children have had almost nothing to eat. They search through our destroyed home for clothes and anything they can use because we have no money left to buy their basic needs.

My daughter Mira is seriously ill, and her iron level has fallen to 6. She urgently needs medicine and treatment. We are also very close to the Yellow Line and need help to move somewhere safer.

Please, if you can, give a small donation. Help me put one meal in front of my children and help Mira receive the medicine she needs. ❤️
